title: CopytradeDeriskPayload
description: De-risk instruction emitted by signal-source-discord when an author follows a BTO with a separate free-form 'de-risk' message (a '0-or-hero' family cue such as '0 or hero' / 'zero or hero', or 'use your own stop') that carries NO BTO/STC/AVG grammar. The sidecar attributes the cue to that same author's preceding BTO (ticker-aware, bounded look-back) and emits this payload per subscribing tenant, carrying the resolved target (ticker, expiry, strike, right) — NOT the OCC option symbol, which CopytradeDeriskWorkflow resolves downstream via ContractActivities.resolve, identical to the BTO path. The workflow trims the open position to a keep-fraction and arms the chandelier trailing stop on the remainder. See docs/plans/PLAN-2026-08-04-copytrade-derisk-followup-cue.md.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope key. Required on every Activity payload and workflow input.

strategy_id.description: Strategy scope key within the tenant.

signal_id.description: Deterministic dedupe key for this de-risk event. Shape: '<cue_message_id>:derisk'. Distinct from any BTO/STC signal_id so the position workflow's exit-dedup never collides.

message_id.description: Discord message id of the de-risk cue message.

author.description: Discord username that posted the de-risk cue (must match the author of the attributed BTO).

posted_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp when the cue message was posted on Discord.

ticker.description: Underlying equity ticker of the attributed target BTO (uppercase, no exchange suffix). RAW underlying — the OCC symbol is composed downstream by ContractActivities.resolve from (ticker, expiry, strike, right).

expiry.description: Option expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the attributed target BTO.

strike.description: Strike price (dollars) of the attributed target BTO.

right.description: Option right of the attributed target BTO: Call or Put.

target_bto_signal_id.description: signal_id of the attributed preceding BTO line, for audit correlation between the de-risk action and the original entry.

target_entry_premium.description: Optional. The attributed BTO's stated fill premium, used only to seed the chandelier trail's initial peak at arm time (it ratchets up on live ticks regardless). Null/absent: the trail seeds its peak from the first live tick.

matched_cue.description: Optional. The normalized cue phrase that fired (e.g. '0 or hero'), recorded for audit. Null/absent: not surfaced.

raw_line.description: The de-risk cue message text as observed, for audit.
